card.name: Parenthetical pointers and section breaks
card.fires_on: Small structural marks in general web articles: a cross-reference such as 'aka', 'see' or 'Fig' inside parentheses, a sentence break, or the third asterisk of a divider. It marks a point where the text turns to a new aside or section.

modes.label: Cross-references and asides
modes.description: Words like aka, see or Fig that open a parenthetical pointer or figure reference.
modes.example: it usually vaporizes, becoming a meteor in the process (<<aka>> a "shooting star").

modes.label: Section dividers and sentence breaks
modes.description: Asterisk dividers or periods and commas where a new sentence or topic begins.

modes.label: Label after a heading
modes.description: The word Category right after a title in a web page header.
modes.example: IUDs And Implants Are Best Forms Of Birth ControlMain<< Category>>: Women's Health / Gynecology
